name: December
source:
December is a nice 15 - 30 minute visual novel about a strange meeting of two people on a December night.

[From [url=https://andbro.itch.io/december]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《December》是一部溫馨的視覺小說，講述兩個人在十二月某個夜晚的一次奇妙相遇，遊玩時間約15至30分鐘。

[摘自[url=https://andbro.itch.io/december]Itch.io[/url]]
